analogy.rationale: RNA synthesis inhibitors directly block transcription, so drugs inhibiting RNA polymerase should phenocopy their transcriptional signature; other nucleic-acid-directed classes (DNA synthesis/repair inhibitors) and translation blockers converge on growth-arrest and stress programs that partially overlap.
